title: Quenched Springy Argentinian Beef Pie
description: A fragrant, jammy beef pie with a springy, laminated puff crust, infused with doenjang for a savory depth, perfect for a solo Argentinian dinner.
instructions: Season the ground beef with salt and pepper and brown it in a skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, garlic, carrot, and celery and cook until the vegetables soften.
Stir in the doenjang and pour in the beef broth, then simmer for 10 minutes until the liquid reduces.
Whisk the flour into the mixture to thicken the sauce and let it simmer for another 2 minutes.
Pat the beef mixture into a 20 cm square baking dish and cover with the puff pastry sheet, sealing the edges.
Brush the pastry with melted butter and bake at 190°C for 20 minutes until the crust puffs and turns golden.
Remove the pie from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Slice the pie into four equal portions and serve warm.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
